rungs.title: Content Assistant
rungs.summary: Learning the brand voice and how content moves from brief to published.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the brand voice, the style guide and the content tools.
rungs.delivery: Writes and edits short pieces from a clear brief, with review on everything.
rungs.leadership: Takes feedback well and keeps editors informed of deadlines.

rungs.title: Content Writer
rungs.summary: Researches, writes and publishes content that does its job.
rungs.knowledge: Writes accurately for the audience, understands SEO basics and checks facts.
rungs.delivery: Takes a brief to a published piece on time, with light edit.
rungs.leadership: Works with designers and subject experts; explains choices clearly.

rungs.title: Senior Content Writer
rungs.summary: Owns a content stream and its quality.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in one subject plus measurement: knows what content works and why.
rungs.delivery: Owns a stream of content end to end and shows its results.
rungs.leadership: Edits and mentors; leads content projects across teams.

rungs.title: Content Lead
rungs.summary: Runs the content calendar, the team and the standards.
rungs.knowledge: Connects content to the funnel, the brand and the numbers.
rungs.delivery: Plans and delivers the content calendar and owns its quality.
rungs.leadership: Leads writers and agrees priorities with marketing and product.

rungs.title: Head of Content
rungs.summary: Sets content strategy and voice for the company.
rungs.knowledge: Owns the brand voice and how AI changes how content is made.
rungs.delivery: Owns content strategy, budget and results.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and speaks for content at executive level.
